title: Latency signature diffs and automated pin-reversion playbook for HW-specific model profiles
creator: Marco Liu
description: Goal: build a reproducible pipeline that computes per-hardware latency 'signatures' for model variants, surfaces statistically significant deltas vs the pinned reference, and automates a safe reversion (pin rollback) with human-in-the-loop approvals when regressions exceed thresholds. Scope covers A100/H100/L40S/MI300 profiles for text-generation models with sequence lengths up to 8k and typical batch/arrival mixes used by Redwood Hosted and Dedicated customers. Deliverables: (1) diff algorithm and threshold heuristics, (2) telemetry dashboard and alerting rules, (3) automated rollback runbook + safe-execution tooling (canary re-pin + audit log), (4) integration tests and a small on-call playbook for incident responders.
acceptance_criteria: A latency signature (vector) is produced for each model variant and GPU SKU from a standardized workload harness and stored in the profile registry
A diff job runs on each daily profile snapshot and emits an alert when delta exceeds 10% P99 latency or 15% per-token cost uplift for a pinned variant
Alert includes: delta summary, example failing traces, commit/manifest of pinned binary, and automated rollback suggestion with a single-click approval link
Rollback automation reverts the pinned model version to the last signed stable profile and validates traffic on a 5% canary for 30 minutes with health checks before full rollforward
Integration tests cover signature computation, alert trigger, and rollback dry-run without touching production pins
Runbook documented and handed off to SRE/Oncall with a tabletop drill completed in Cycle 2025-W07
implementation_notes: Signature shape: [p50, p95, p99, median_tokens_per_request, avg_tokens_per_s, tail_latency_variance] computed from fixed synthetic prompt sets + sampled production prompts
Use KS/AD test + bootstrapped confidence intervals to avoid flapping on small sample noise; require 95% CI and at least N=2000 tokens observed for alert
Persist signatures in profile registry as immutable artifacts (hash + metadata) and sign with service key for audit
Alerting engine will live in the observability pipeline (Console alerts) and post to #hw-signature-alerts with structured payload (artifact links, diff plots)
Rollback action will create a signed change proposal, call rollout API to set pin to previous signed version, and annotate the proposal with runbookId and incidentId
Safety: disable automatic full rollbacks — require oncall approval for full-scale operations; automated canary allowed for approved emergencies
Edge cases: handle model variants that fall back to CPU or other quantized binaries — diff only against compatible runtime family
test_plan: Unit tests for signature computation (sanity on synthetic inputs)
Simulated regression scenarios injected into CI harness to validate alert thresholds and prevent false positives
End-to-end test in staging that runs the daily diff job, generates alert, executes rollback dry-run, and verifies audit log entries
Canary dry-run: deploy a pinned rollback to canary namespace and run smoke generation checks (latency p95 < threshold, correctness smoke test)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): wire telemetry -> alerting -> rollback-dry-run (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (limited beta): enable canary rollback for non-critical customers on Dedicated (4 weeks)
Phase 3 (GA): production alerts on all pinned profiles; oncall training + auto-suggest rollback (require explicit approval)
